notes: Stories added for EVAL-CT-M3 covering schema, logic, API integration, tests, and service integration.

EVAL-CT-M3-S1.title: Define Relevance Scoring Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M3-S1.description: Define a structured schema for trial relevance including condition match, eligibility alignment, and overall relevance score. Extend Pydantic models to validate inputs and outputs.

EVAL-CT-M3-S2.title: Implement Condition and Eligibility Matching Logic
EVAL-CT-M3-S2.description: Build core logic to compare user query intent against trial condition fields and eligibility criteria, producing normalized relevance signals.

EVAL-CT-M3-S3.title: Expose Relevance Signals via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M3-S3.description: Integrate relevance scoring into evaluate_care_facade so trial search responses include structured relevance indicators for downstream rendering.

EVAL-CT-M3-S4.title: Unit Tests for Relevance Matching Logic
EVAL-CT-M3-S4.description: Create unit tests validating condition matching, eligibility parsing, partial matches, and edge cases such as missing criteria.

EVAL-CT-M3-S5.title: Integrate Relevance Scoring into Clinical Trials Service Flow
EVAL-CT-M3-S5.description: Embed relevance computation into clinical_trials_service pipeline so all returned trials include computed relevance before being passed to the facade.
